page: How to use a Promo Tile

fields.guidePurpose: Use a promo tile to point at one thing worth noticing.
fields.guideWhenToUse: Reach for a promo tile when a page needs a pointer rather than a paragraph.

guideProperties.label: Promo Legacy Style
guideProperties.information: Left over from the old build. Ask before using it.

guideProperties.label: Promo Spacing
guideProperties.information: Pick Loose when the tile sits alone.
